title: Neuroformer: Multimodal and Multitask Generative Pretraining for Brain Data
goal: Reproduce the original empirical VisNav neural-prediction and behavioral-decoding result family, including source pretrained-versus-from-scratch data-budget comparisons and joint-training/modality-input ablations. Preserve each named result's original recording support, visible modalities, temporal conventions, label/pretraining budgets and metric. Assess improvement against qualified source comparators on the same named panel. Retain simulation/connectivity and separate Passive-Stim/V1AL experiments as distinct source evidence, and label protected split, clock or scoring amendments as extensions. A single speed gain does not establish completion of the retained VisNav family.

success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v2.json and improvement.primary-scope.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
